purpose: Teach: ジャングル/大谷/月日/レンタカー/横須賀/姓/細工/繁華

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、図鑑で、ジャングルの動物、見てたよ、ぼく、すごいなって、思ったんだ、本当に、ライオン、虎、いっぱい、いるんだね、本当に。
lines.en: Mom, I was looking at the encyclopedia — the jungle animals — and I thought they were so amazing. Like, there really are lions and tigers and so many of them, you know?
lines.style: Breathless, cascading wonder. Words tumble out with genuine astonishment. Soft excitement, not performed — he's still processing what he saw. Voice lifts slightly on the animal names.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。大谷選手の試合、お父さんと、夜中まで、見てたわね、翔くん、興奮、すごかったわよね、本当に、楽しかったよね、家族で、応援。
lines.en: Yes. You and Dad stayed up so late watching that Ohtani game the other night, didn't you? You were so excited, Sho. It was really fun, all of us cheering together.
lines.style: Warm, observant recall. Gentle smile in the voice. She's anchoring his excitement with her own quiet pleasure — not matching his energy but validating it. Settling, maternal.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママと、お祭り、行ってから、もう、月日、経ったね、また、行きたいよ、ぼく、今度の夏、絶対、行こうね、ママ、約束しようね。
lines.en: It feels like so much time has passed since we went to the festival together. I want to go again. Can we promise we'll go this summer, Mom? We have to.
lines.style: Earnest, almost pleading. The 'have to' carries a child's logic — it matters because it matters. Slight tension underneath the eagerness, like he's worried she might say no. Leaning forward in his voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 夏休み、お父さんが、レンタカー、予約してくれたわよ、翔くん、家族旅行、楽しみね、本当に、わくわくするわよね、私たち、皆。
lines.en: Dad already booked a rental car for summer break, Sho. The family trip — we're all looking forward to it so much. I can feel the excitement already.
lines.style: Warm, reassuring certainty. She's answering his unspoken worry. Voice has that settled-joy quality of a plan already made. Light, easy, the voice of someone thinking about a good thing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 横須賀の、お祖父ちゃんち、行きたいよ、ママ、いつ、行く予定なの?ぼく、本当に、楽しみだよ、ね、お母さん、教えて、いつ?
lines.en: I want to go to Grandpa's place in Yokosuka. When are we going, Mom? I'm really excited about it. When, Mom? Tell me when.
lines.style: Rapid-fire, building anticipation. Each question stacks on the last — impatience mixed with genuine wonder. High, bright energy. Not whining, but insistent in the way small children are when something thrills them.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お母さんの姓、結婚で、変わったのよ、翔くん、知ってた、おじいちゃんと、おばあちゃんの姓は、違うのよ、お祖父ちゃんの方の姓だわ。
lines.en: My last name changed when I got married, Sho. Did you know that? Your grandparents' last names were different — Grandpa's side, that's the one I have now.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly distant. She's explaining something she's reflecting on as she speaks. Measured pace, like she's choosing words carefully. Not talking to him so much as thinking aloud with him nearby.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんが、細工で、おもちゃ、作ってくれたんだよ、ママ、見て、本当に、すごいよね、お祖父ちゃん、本当に、手先、器用なんだ。
lines.en: Grandpa made this toy by hand for me. Look, Mom. Isn't it incredible? He's so skilled with his hands.
lines.style: Proud admiration, almost reverent. He's presenting something precious. Quiet respect in the voice — this is about more than a toy. He wants her to see what he sees in his grandfather.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 繁華街、家族で、お買い物、また、行きましょうね、翔くん、お父さんも、たまの息抜きで、行きたがってるわよ、本当に、楽しみね、皆で。
lines.en: Let's go shopping downtown with the family again soon, okay Sho? Your dad wants a little break like that too — he's been saying so. It'll be fun, all of us together.
lines.style: Warm, inclusive, gently planning. She's weaving him into a family plan, making him feel needed. Voice carries that close-to-you quality of a mother settling something good. Soft landing on the final phrase.
